submitted.rationale: Of three photocurrent measurements across the composition line, Ba0.49Mn0.51 (near the BaMnO3 composition) gave the highest photocurrent, 2.95e-6 A. The Mn-rich end (Ba0.17) gave 1.07e-6 A and the Ba-rich side (Ba0.61, near Ba3Mn2O8) gave 4e-8 A, so the peak is near the 1:1 composition.
